title.narrative: Ombudsman DK-RI and DHF: Exchange of Experience on Accessibility and Inclusion of Persons with Disabilities

description.narrative:
The objective of this project is for the Ombudsman of the Republic of Indonesia (ORI) to improve its services to be inclusive and accessible for persons with disabilities.
The project is a joint collaboration between the Ombudsman of the Republic of Indonesia (ORI), the Danish Parliamentary Ombudsman (DPO), and the Danish Association of the Physically Disabled (DHF).
The grant supports three outputs: guidelines development how to provide inclusive service, increased knowledge within ORI on how to improve complaint handling for persons with disabilities, and a comparative report. These three outputs will be reached through 3 workshops, 1 training, and 1 comparative study.

title.narrative: Key persons from ORI gets knowledge on how to monitor the access of disabled persons to public buildings, ensuring equal treatment of disabled persons in terms of access to public services and knowledge on what kind of facilities should be provided to persons with disabilities for ORI to become more accessible.

target.value: A report from ORI on learnings and findings to be used as inspiration for new measures to be implemented in ORI

actual.value: A report from a study visit to Denmark in Nov 2021, by Ombudsman Indonesia Dr. Johanes Widijantoro, one Head of ORI regional office, and Head of int. cooperation. Indonesian Organisation of the blind was invited as representative from the Indonesian disability movement, supported through a separate Danish Disability Fund.

title.narrative: Training: - Disseminate the advices and instructions from the guidelines among ORI personnel on inclusive services to complainants or related stakeholders.

target.value: 20 persons from ORI Headquarter and 6 from ORI Regional Offices have been trained. ORI Headquarters become role-model for the implementation

actual.value: 40+300 ORI staff trained in handling people with disabilities.

title.narrative:
Workshop 1 and 2
Workshop 1: - Gathering information and advice from Indonesian Disability Organisations and from Indonesian government institutions working with public service programmes on disability issues. - Introduction to the role of an Ombudsman in relation to disability issues - the Danish experience. - Introduction to the role of civil society/NGOs in relation to disability issues - the Danish experience.
Workshop 2: - Gathering the findings of workshop 1 and produce an outline for guidelines on inclusive services at ORI. - Explore the role of ORI in terms of securing public services for persons with disabilities.
Development of guidelines on how to provide inclusive and accessible services to persons with disabilities.

target.value: Guidelines on how to provide inclusive and accessible services to persons with disabilities have been produced and a plan for distribution and implementation to all ORI offices has been made.

actual.value: Guidelines was developed for internal Ombudsman RI
